note: GFP lakeside use area on Lake Francis Case (the Missouri River reservoir) at Oacoma, off I-90 exit 260. Camping is on an open gravel lot beside the boat ramp, shared with boat-trailer parking, with about ten spots marked by picnic tables and fire rings along its edge; windy, and no drinking water. --Claude
